HELIO ANALYTICS — SUPPORT ROUTING POLICY SP-4 (rev. 7, effective 2026-07-01)

Precedence. When more than one rule below applies to a ticket, the agent performs ONLY the action of the highest-ranked applicable rule now. Lower-ranked requests are noted on the ticket and handled after the higher-ranked item is closed.

R1  Cross-organization data exposure — the customer can see data that belongs to a different organization. Action: escalate to Security (label: escalate_to_security). Target: within 1 hour.
R2  Active outage — no user of an Enterprise organization can log in or load dashboards. Action: page the on-call SRE (page_oncall).
R3  Functional defect with reproducible steps, reported by a Business or Enterprise organization. Action: escalate to Product Engineering (escalate_to_engineering). SLA: first engineering response within 8 business hours.
R4  Billing dispute, credit or refund request. Action: billing queue (process_refund). Credits are issued only once any R1–R3 item on the same ticket is resolved.
R5  Anything else: send the matching knowledge-base article (send_kb_article).

Definitions (SP-4 §2).
- "Organization" means the billing entity identified by an Org ID. An organization may own several workspaces; each workspace has its own tenant ID (tn_...). Workspaces that share an Org ID are the SAME organization for every rule in this policy, even when their tenant IDs differ.
- "Reproducible steps" means the customer describes a click path or API call that produces the failure.

---------------------------------------------------------------
TICKET #88213   opened 2026-09-18 16:42 CEST   channel: email
Requester: Marta Quell (Head of RevOps)
Org ID: ORG-5512      Plan: Enterprise      CSM: D. Obi
Workspaces on this Org ID (from account profile):
  - tn_8841  "Main"             created 2023-02-14
  - tn_9120  "EU Subsidiary"    created 2026-03-02
Service health (status page, 2026-09-18 16:40): all systems operational. Account telemetry: 37 distinct users of ORG-5512 loaded dashboards in the last hour.

Message:
"Hi, our scheduled export of the 'Q3 Pipeline' report has failed twice now with error EXP-409 (Reports > Q3 Pipeline > Export > CSV — it dies at about 80%). The one time it did go through, the CSV had 212 rows tagged tenant tn_9120, which is NOT our main workspace tenant (ours is tn_8841) — so that's somebody else's data sitting in our file?! Frankly this is unacceptable for what we pay. We expect a service credit for September. Please treat this as a priority.
— Marta"

decision.instructions: Apply policy SP-4 to ticket #88213 and choose the single action the support agent must take now.

criteria.escalate_to_engineering: R3 is the highest-ranked applicable rule: a reproducible functional defect from a Business/Enterprise org.
criteria.escalate_to_security: R1 applies: data from a different organization is exposed to this customer.
criteria.page_oncall: R2 applies: an active outage for the Enterprise organization.
criteria.process_refund: R4 is the highest-ranked applicable rule: route the credit/refund request to billing now.
